thread:
alex: Quick sync — I'm going to start the staged rollout for structured-output / function-calling across SDKs tomorrow 9am PT. Need confirmation on canary audiences, compat behaviour for old clients, and the auto-rollback guard.

sasha: Ack. Suggested split: internal integrators first, small % on mobile, tiny on web. Propose 5% internal, 3% mobile, 1% web.

pankaj: Note: clients < v2.3 must be forced into compat mode (no fncall). I'll add a client-version check in the surface. Who flips the flags?

maya: I can flip them and watch telemetry. I'll run the rollout script and keep a close eye on fncall errors. Need exact flag key + telemetry event names.

alex: Flag key: structured_output.v1.enabled. Telemetry events to watch: so.feature_flag, so.fncall_error_rate, so.latency_p50, so.latency_p95. Also emit so.client_compat_mode with values (legacy|strict).

alex: Example rollout config I'll use:
```json
{
  "flag": "structured_output.v1.enabled",
  "audiences": [
    {"segment": "internal", "pct": 5},
    {"segment": "mobile_stable", "pct": 3},
    {"segment": "web_beta", "pct": 1}
  ],
  "compat_default": true,
  "auto_rollback_on": {"error_rate_increase_pct": 100, "duration_min": 10}
}
```

claire: deploy-bot scheduled the canary job for 2026-03-18T16:00Z. Leaving a note in the deployment calendar.

deploy-bot: Canary started: structured_output.v1.enabled -> internal(5%), mobile_stable(3%), web_beta(1%).

sasha: I'll add a small smoke test to the e2e harness that calls a representative fncall flow and validates the JSON schema + fallback path. Quick check: where do we put the sample prompts?

pankaj: Put sample prompts in eng-ml/so-smokecases repo. Also important: JS SDK surface will expose enableStructuredOutput flag, but for clients older than 2.3 it will no-op and include header `X-SO-Compat: legacy`. Confirmed?

alex: Confirmed. Server-side shim will detect legacy clients and translate structured outputs into plain text or simple key-value responses so old clients don't break.

maya: Monitoring plan: alert if so.fncall_error_rate > 2% sustained for 15m => pause rollout. Also alert if so.latency_p95 increases by >200ms vs baseline for 10m. I'll add dashboards and pager rules.

claire: Can we add a quick integrator note header (X-SO-Compat) and a short guide (1–2 bullets) for partners who consume responses? I can draft the support note.

sasha: I'll post a ~5 line blurb to #support once the canary is stable for 2 hours with rollout details and guidance for integrators.

maya: Plan: wait 30 minutes after canary start, if no regression bump, increase mobile to 10% then watch for 60m before next step.

alex: Perfect. If any failing tests, schema waivers, or odd non-JSON payloads surface, ping me immediately. Also please attach one example payload to the ticket so eng-ml can triage. :thumbsup:
